causal_hypothesis: A rising lagged theoretical miner revenue per unit of hash may reduce miner balance-sheet stress and forced BTC selling while identifying demand strong enough to compensate increasing network competition.
economic_hypothesis: A weekly full-capital BTC long-or-zero-yield-cash policy may preserve sufficient upside while avoiding deteriorating miner-economics states to improve fee- and slippage-adjusted drawdown and Calmar versus matched buy-and-hold across Design, Validation and annual folds.

independence_boundary.not_closed_hashrate_growth: The closed hashrate family treated rising hashrate as network confidence and admitted DRA entries. This proxy divides price-valued protocol subsidy plus fees by hashrate to represent miner revenue pressure and drives a standalone policy.
independence_boundary.not_closed_fee_pressure: The closed fee-pressure family used total BTC fees alone as a congestion signal. Fees are only one revenue component here and cannot determine the proxy without subsidy, BTC price and hashrate.
independence_boundary.not_closed_btc_trend: BTC price is only the USD conversion leg of miner revenue and cannot determine the proxy without protocol revenue and network competition.
independence_boundary.required_nonredundancy: Before economics, absolute Spearman correlation of the frozen weekly proxy change with matched BTC price return, hashrate growth and fee-pressure growth must each be at most 0.80 in both Design and Validation.

adversarial_prior: The theoretical 144-block daily assumption omits realized block-count variation and therefore is not actual miner revenue per hash.
The feature may be dominated by BTC price momentum or the mechanical subsidy halving rather than miner balance-sheet pressure.
Coin Metrics present-vintage reviewed observations do not prove original historical availability, so any historical pass still requires untouched OOS.
The two-week and eight-week variants are rejection-only stability checks and cannot replace a failed four-week primary.
stop_conditions: Stop before feature construction if any corpus identity, daily pairing, seven-day week, subsidy schedule or publication-lag binding fails.
Stop DUPLICATE_REJECT before economics if any frozen proxy-change Spearman absolute correlation exceeds 0.80 against BTC price return, hashrate growth or fee-pressure growth in Design or Validation.

Stop NO_CANDIDATE if the four-week primary or either rejection-only neighbor fails any Design, Validation, annual breadth, cost, drawdown, Calmar, upside, concentration, holding or terminal-inventory gate.

Do not replace expected block count with realized block count, change subsidy dates, scan another lookback, threshold, normalization, lag, holding interval, sizing rule, leverage or short leg after outcome access.
Do not combine this proxy with DRA or another closed factor as a rescue.
missing_proof: No deterministic proxy ledger, nonredundancy audit, economic runner or frozen manifest exists.
